events.description: A dark-colored sedan collides with the rear driver's side of a stationary silver sedan, causing visible deformation and pushing the silver car forward slightly.

A dark sedan in the left lane loses control, veers sharply right across the center line, and collides with an unseen object or vehicle on the right shoulder/edge of the road, resulting in the car rotating and coming to rest partially off the pavement. The event unfolds continuously from frame f0 to f15.

A dark sedan loses control, veers sharply left across the road, and begins rotating counter-clockwise; by t=41.0s it is nearly perpendicular to traffic direction with its front right wheel lifted off the ground, indicating a loss of traction or impact initiating a crash.

The sedan completes a full spin and comes to rest sideways on the left side of the road; a detached object (likely a wheel or undercarriage component) is visible on the pavement near the vehicle from f2 onward, confirming a structural failure or collision.
A white sedan collides head-on with another vehicle at an intersection; the front of the white car is severely crumpled and its headlights are on, indicating an active crash event.

A separate incident: a silver sedan (possibly a Lada) is seen stopped in the middle of an intersection with visible front-end damage; surrounding vehicles maneuver around it, suggesting a prior collision occurred just before or during this interval.

A white sedan abruptly swerves left from the right lane into the path of the dashcam vehicle, making contact and causing a collision. The impact is visible as the white car's rear quarter panel and taillight are struck, and the car rotates sharply before moving out of frame.

A white sedan abruptly cuts across the lane from the left, swerving sharply in front of the dashcam vehicle, nearly causing a collision; the white car’s brake lights illuminate intensely as it corrects its trajectory.
